profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Assets Protection at Target
profile.summary: Sara is an engineer on the Device Reliability team, working to improve in store experiences for guests and team members alike.  She is working on connecting systems for Enterprise-wide Asset Management.  Sara is also a co-founder of Target Tech Kids, a group working to empower and inspire young minds to explore the world of technology in a fun and welcoming environment.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description: Maintain responsibilities from previous Engineer role while deepening involvement in the Support Department including added leadership and customer satisfaction improvements.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
Technical Account Manager supporting over 30 customers across the US and internationally.
Provide engineering support to power utilities to run their SCADA system.
Provide training for customers to gain a better understanding of the SCADA software.
Manage an average of 60 customer tickets at any given time.
Have also worked on a project from start to end to provide an upgrade to an existing customer.

positions.title: Guest Services
positions.description: I worked as an usher providing hospitality to the guests.

volunteerExperiences.description: Help mentor a high school robotics team.  This includes helping students learn the different aspects (programming, mechanical, electrical, marketing) that work together to create a robot and prepare for a new competition each year.

Volunteer at the robotics competitions in Minnesota each year.

Spare Parts Attendant - Assist teams determine what spare parts are needed. 
Queuer
Lead Queuer - Directs and supervises the Team Queuers, determines team traffic flow on and off the field, monitors flow during the competition. Helps ensure smooth flow of match play and maintaining the pace of the event.
Senior Field Reset - Interface between teams and the Field Management System to coordinate the field configuration in a timely manner.

projects.title: Sit-Stand System
projects.description: Senior Design Project: Work on a team to design a system that determines when a standing desk is in the sitting or standing position and whether or not some is present at the desk.  The system is designed for research, to track how long someone is sitting or standing at their desk to promote the health benefits of standing desks.  A windows application could be configured to notify the user if they have been seated for too long.to prevent sitting disease.

projects.title: LED 5-Cent Instrument Tuner
projects.description:
Junior-year design project.

Instrument Tuner accurate to 30 cents (+ or -) of 440 Hz (A below middle C).  13 LEDs indicated every 5 cents around 440 Hz for high-precision tuning.  2 9V battery operation, low power.  10 mV analog microphone signal to analog circuitry fed PIC12F683 microcontroller and logic circuitry.  

Experience from project:

Board layout in Altium, group work, project management, deadline attainment; product conception, simulating, prototyping, testing, production.
